Selected Work

Design Approach

Designing interiors as narratives.

Balancing function, atmosphere, proportion and material — each project begins with spatial thinking: understanding how a room is entered, how light moves through it, and how materials meet.

The work moves from concept to technical resolution — drawings, details, and construction logic — so the final space is not only visualized, but built with intent.

Profile

About

GAD is an interior designer and interior architect working at the intersection of spatial design, materiality, and visualization.

The practice is built on a belief that a space should be thought through before it's rendered — that plans, sections, and details are not afterthoughts but the foundation of the design. Work spans residential, hospitality, and commercial interiors, moving from brief and concept through to technical resolution and final visualization.

The aim is to combine the sensibility of a designer with the rigor of an architect — to design space, develop it, visualize it, and understand how it's actually built.
